fields.name_zh: B25_1.「吃飯」---量表內容
fields.description_zh:

2：需人灌食或只能嘴動，手不會舀，需人餵食
fields.name_zh_en: B25_1. "Eating" -- scale content
fields.description_en:
0: None
1: Needs help cutting or mashing food, or help putting on or taking off eating aids
2: Needs tube feeding, or can only move the mouth and cannot scoop food by hand, needs to be fed

fields.name_zh: B25_2.「從床上坐起及移位到椅子(或輪椅)上」---量表內容
fields.description_zh:
0：無
1：坐起及移位過程中需他人些微協助(如：輕扶以保持平衡，或提醒，或因安全顧慮需有人在旁監督)
2：可自行獨立坐起，但由床移位到椅子上時，須 1人大量的肢體協助
3：需人協助才能坐起，或需 2人幫忙扶持才可移位
fields.name_zh_en: B25_2. "Sitting up from bed and transferring to a chair (or wheelchair)" --- scale content
fields.description_en:
0: None
1: Needs slight help from others in sitting up and transferring (e.g., light support to maintain balance, reminders, or supervision nearby for safety concerns)
2: Can sit up independently, but needs substantial physical help from 1 person to transfer from bed to chair
3: Needs help to sit up, or needs support from 2 people to transfer

fields.name_zh: B25_3.「上廁所(包括到馬桶、穿脫衣物、擦拭、沖水)」---量表內容
fields.description_zh:
0：無
1：只需協助保持平衡，整理衣物或使用衛生紙
2：需人大量協助
fields.name_zh_en: B25_3. "Using the toilet (including getting to the toilet, dressing/undressing, wiping, flushing)" --- scale content
fields.description_en:
0: None
1: Needs help only with keeping balance, arranging clothes or using toilet paper
2: Needs substantial assistance from others

fields.name_zh: B25_4.「洗澡」---量表內容
fields.description_zh:
0：無
1：需別人協助或監督才能完成
fields.name_zh_en: B25_4. "Bathing" --- scale description
fields.description_en:
0: No
1: Needs help or supervision from others to complete

fields.name_zh: B25_5「. 在平地走50公尺以上或操作輪椅」---量表內容
fields.description_zh:
0：無
1：需稍微扶持或口頭教導，即可行走50公尺以上
2：可以操作輪椅
3：操作輪椅需要幫忙，或行走時需大量扶持，或無法行走
fields.name_zh_en: B25_5 "Walking more than 50 meters on level ground or operating a wheelchair" --- scale content
fields.description_en:
0: None
1: Needs slight support or verbal instruction to walk 50 meters or more
2: Can operate a wheelchair
3: Needs help to operate a wheelchair, or needs substantial support when walking, or cannot walk

fields.name_zh: B25_6.「穿脫衣褲鞋襪(義肢、支架)」---量表內容
fields.description_zh:
0：無
1：在別人幫忙下，可自行完成一半以上動作
2：需別人完全幫忙
fields.name_zh_en: B25_6. "Putting on and taking off clothes, trousers, shoes and socks (prosthesis, brace)" --- scale content
fields.description_en:
0: None
1: With others' help, can complete more than half of the movements on their own
2: Needs complete help from others

fields.name_zh: B25_7.「刷牙、洗臉、洗手、梳頭髮、刮鬍子(男性)」---量表內容
fields.name_zh_en: B25_7. "Brushing teeth, washing face, washing hands, combing hair, shaving (male)" --- scale content

fields.name_zh: B25_8.「上下樓梯一層樓」---量表內容
fields.description_zh:
0：無
1：需稍扶持或口頭指導或監督
2：無法或需大量協助
fields.name_zh_en: B25_8. "Going up and down one flight of stairs" --- scale description
fields.description_en:
0: None
1: Needs slight support or verbal guidance or supervision
2: Unable, or needs substantial assistance

fields.name_zh: B25_9.「控制大便(大便失禁)」---量表內容
fields.description_zh:
0：無
1：偶爾會失禁(每週不超過一次)或使用塞劑(軟便劑)時需人幫忙
2：需人協助處理
fields.name_zh_en: B25_9. "Bowel control (fecal incontinence)" --- scale content
fields.description_en:
0: None
1: Occasionally incontinent (no more than once a week) or needs help when using suppositories (stool softeners)
2: Needs assistance to manage

fields.name_zh: B25_10.「控制小便(小便失禁)」---量表內容
fields.description_zh:
0：無
1：偶爾會失禁(每週不超過一次)或使用尿布尿袋時需人幫忙
2：需人協助處理廿六、工具性日常生活的活動能力
fields.name_zh_en: B25_10. "Bladder control (urinary incontinence)" --- scale content
fields.description_en:
0: None
1: Occasionally incontinent (no more than once a week) or needs help when using diapers or urine bags
2: Needs assistance to manage 26. Instrumental activities of daily living

fields.description_en:
1: No need to do this activity
2: Can independently meet all shopping needs
3: Can independently buy daily necessities
4: Needs someone to accompany every shopping trip
5: Cannot shop outside at all
99: Don't know/refused

fields.name_zh: B26_2.請問您能不能自己一個人外出活動？
fields.description_zh:
1：不需要從事此活動
2：能夠自己開車、騎車
3：能夠自己搭乘大眾運輸工具
4：能夠自己搭乘計程車但不會搭乘大眾運輸工具

6：完全不能出門
99：不知道/拒答
fields.name_zh_en: B26_2. Can you go out for activities by yourself?
fields.description_en:
1: No need to do this activity
2: Can drive or ride by oneself
3: Can take public transport by oneself
4: Can take a taxi by oneself but not public transport
5: Can take a taxi or public transport when accompanied, e.g., driven or accompanied by family
6: Cannot go out at all
99: Don't know/refused

fields.name_zh: B26_3.請問您能不能自己一個人做食物烹調？
fields.description_zh:

2：能獨立計畫、烹煮和擺設一頓適當的飯菜
3：如果準備好一切佐料，會做一頓適當的飯菜
4：會將已做好的飯菜加熱
5：需要別人把飯菜煮好、擺好
99：不知道/拒答
fields.name_zh_en: B26_3. Can you cook food by yourself?
fields.description_en:
1: No need to do this activity
2: Can independently plan, cook and serve an adequate meal
3: Can prepare an adequate meal if all ingredients are provided
4: Can heat up already prepared meals
5: Needs someone to cook and serve the meals
99: Don't know/refused

fields.name_zh: B26_4.請問您能不能自己一個人做家事？
fields.description_zh:
1：不需要從事此活動
2：能做較繁重的家事或需偶爾協助家事（如搬動沙發、擦地板、洗窗戶）
3：能做較簡單的家事，如洗碗、鋪床、疊被
4：能做家事，但不能達到可被接受的整潔程度
5：所有的家事都需要別人協助
6：完全不能做家事
99：不知道/拒答
fields.name_zh_en: B26_4. Can you do housework by yourself?
fields.description_en:
1: Not required to do this activity
2: Can do heavier housework or occasionally needs help with housework (e.g., moving a sofa, mopping floors, washing windows)
3: Can do simpler housework, such as washing dishes, making the bed, folding quilts
4: Can do housework but cannot reach an acceptable level of cleanliness
5: Needs help with all housework
6: Completely unable to do housework
99: Don't know/Refused

fields.name_zh: B26_5.請問您能不能自己一個人洗衣服？
fields.description_zh:

2：能自己清洗所有衣物
3：只能清洗小件衣物
4：完全依賴他人
99：不知道/拒答

fields.description_en:

3: Can only wash small items
4: Completely dependent on others
99: Don't know/refused

fields.name_zh: B26_6.請問您能不能自己一個人使用電話？

2：能獨立使用電話，含查電話簿、撥號等
3：僅可撥熟悉的電話號碼
4：僅會接電話，不會撥電話
5：完全不會使用電話
99：不知道/拒答
fields.name_zh_en: B26_6. Can you use the telephone by yourself?
fields.description_en:
1: No need to do this activity
2: Can use the telephone independently, including looking up numbers and dialing
3: Can only dial familiar numbers
4: Can only answer calls, cannot dial
5: Cannot use the telephone at all
99: Don't know/refused

fields.name_zh: B26_7.請問您能不能自己一個人服用藥物？

2：能自己負責在正確的時間用正確的藥物
3：需要提醒或少許協助
4：如果事先準備好服用的藥物份量，可自行服用
5：不能自己服用藥物
99：不知道/拒答
fields.name_zh_en: B26_7. Can you take medication by yourself?
fields.description_en:
1: No need to do this activity
